items.title: What decision fatigue feels like
items.caption:
I wake up and go downstairs. I pass the messy kitchen and know I should do the dishes, my most difficult chore. I pass the laundry room and know I should do laundry. I walk into the bathroom: the sink, the mirror, the shower wall. I walk back through the same rooms to the living room. This is the room we live in, and you can tell. And I sit down on the couch, the biggest mistake I can make.

I'm aware of everything that needs doing, and each thing demands my attention. With it comes guilt.

Some days I wake up with the energy to get something done. But with a list that long, where do I start? Decision fatigue drains my ambition, and I spend so long deciding that I don't want to do anything anymore.

That's why I made Level Vibes. On a Level 1 day it picks one thing, like laundry, and I've accomplished something. 💚💛❤️

Free on the App Store, link in bio.
